violations.why: irq_pebble (priority 4) can preempt irq_tide (priority 3) between its write and its re-read, so the check at line 50 can see a different value.
irq_husk (priority 5) can preempt irq_tide between the write and the re-read and change v_saffron.
irq_drift (priority 6) can preempt irq_tide between the write and the re-read and change v_saffron.
irq_drift (priority 6) can preempt irq_husk (priority 5) between its write and the re-read of v_saffron.
irq_husk (priority 5) can preempt irq_nook (priority 2) between the two reads in fn_oasis, so the two reads can return different values.
irq_drift (priority 6) can preempt irq_nook between the two reads of v_lantern in fn_oasis and write it. Both guards, v_yew and v_harbor, can be 1.
irq_drift's fn_upland can preempt a lower ISR between its fn_lagoon and fn_shoal writes of v_birch. It then reads a transient value.
irq_drift's fn_upland can preempt a lower ISR between its fn_lagoon and fn_shoal writes of v_meadow. It then reads a transient value.
